'''Vice-Commandant''' was a rank used by the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. During the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the rank was held by [[Grevin]], under [[Toborro]], in opposition to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike force and the citizens of [[Makeb]],<ref name="Hitting">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Hitting the Hutts|Makeb}}</ref> as well as [[Edrii]], [[Harlal]], and [[Tergos]] under [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]].<ref name="Revenge of the Archon">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Revenge of the Archon|Makeb}}</ref>
